title: Restriction of scalars commutes with intrinsic realization and pullback
statement: Let φ:A→B be a map of finite commutative rings, p:Z→Y any scheme morphism and N an arbitrary object of D(Y_et,B). Let F, a, L_A and U denote the intrinsic realization, its geometric inverse-mate comparison, pullback, and intrinsic restriction [def-fix-etale-origin-scalar-pullback-data]. Let ρ_T:F_T^B U_T≅U_et F_T^A be properOriginRestrictionIso [def-fix-proper-etale-origin-scalar-data], and a_i:L_A U_Y→U_Z L_B the specified restriction/pullback map. Then L_A(ρ_Y.inv_N);a_i(F_Y^B N);U_Z(a_B(N)) = a_A(U_et N);F_Z^A(a_et(N));ρ_Z.inv_(L_et,B N), where a_et is Etale.scalarRestrictionPullbackIso.hom. This tensor-free cube has no extension of scalars or right-adjoint projection.

proof.text: Use the all-complex right-derived unit normalization to prove horizontal naturality of normalized squares. Apply it to the identity-on-sections coefficient comparison and the ordinary pushforwardCongr isomorphism underlying properOriginPushIso. The canonical restriction mate satisfies canonicalDerivedMate_factors, whereas sfDerivedImageRestriction.inv satisfies compactSupportScalarDirectNormalization. The underived cube commutes because every comparison fixes sections. This identifies their specified derived maps without assuming that scalar restriction preserves K-injectives.

proof.text: Invert realizationRestriction_directImage_cube as an equality of composite isomorphisms. Insert the normalized properOriginPushIso squares from the previous step and use naturality. Apply injectivity of the mates correspondence and its compatibility with horizontal pasting to obtain the restriction/pullback cube for intrinsic realization on the fixed-scalar pro-etale category.

proof.text: Use compatibility of mates with pasting and top/bottom whiskering to expand originPullback as the fixed-site pullback comparison followed by the intrinsic realization inverse mate, transported by intrinsicSiteFunctorIso at both endpoints. supportComparison_eq identifies the site map with directImageComparisonAmbientPullbackIso. Paste the existing derived restriction cube for the etale/pro-etale site comparison with the intrinsic cube from the previous step. Naturality cancels the intermediate coefficient-realization isomorphisms and gives precisely the stated inverse-endpoint cube.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleOriginRestrictionPullbackCube
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Y)
    (N : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) Y) :
    (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A p).map
        ((properOriginRestrictionIso φ Y).inv.app N) ≫
      (originRestrictionPullback φ p).app
        ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Y B).obj N) ≫
      (scalarMateRestriction φ Z).mapDerivedCategory.map ((originPullback B p).app N) =
    (originPullback A p).app
        ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)).obj N) ≫
      (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).map
        ((Etale.scalarRestrictionPullbackIso
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) p).hom.app N) ≫
      (properOriginRestrictionIso φ Z).inv.app
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          N)
